description: This file defines queue management functions for jQuery, including queue, dequeue, clearQueue, and promise, and extends jQuery's prototype with these methods.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Adds or retrieves a queue of functions for a DOM element.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and executes the next function in the queue for a DOM element.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.description: Clears the queue of a DOM element.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that is resolved when the queue of a DOM element is emptied.
